name: intact-simulation
description: Create and verify parametric CAD parts and assemblies, inspect native dimensions, export engineering files and run supported simulation studies through ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Create parametric CAD parts and assemblies through ChatGPT on Windows. Inspect native geometry, verify dimensions and holes, edit constrained sketches and feature history, and export STEP, STL, GLB and 3MF. Includes sampled TPMS lattices and bounded thermal, linear-elastic and creeping-flow studies. Review can request a geometry accuracy check through your signed-in OpenAI local client. CAD execution stays in Windows isolation. Requires the Windows desktop app; outputs need engineering review before manufacture or safety-critical use.
defaultPrompt: Create a six-hole pipe flange with an 80 mm outer diameter and a 24 mm bore.
Design a two-part electronics enclosure and show an exploded view.
